'''Karlsu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] stationed at [[Tower command station|Waypoint Station Aurek]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Karlsu was part of a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] team sent to escort researchers into the wreckage of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] the ''[[Endar Spire]]''. The only survivor of his team, Karlsu aided a Republic-allied individual sent by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Childress]] in defeating the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] forces within the ruined ship.

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Karlsu joined the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. By the year [[3643 BBY]], Karlsu had achieved the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. He served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Childress]] at [[Tower command station|Waypoint Station Aurek]], as part of the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]'s security forces.<ref name="TOR" />

When Republic forces identified the remains of the ''[[Endar Spire]]'', the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that [[Darth Malak]] had attacked [[3956 BBY|over 300 years ago]] in an attempt to kill the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]], Captain Childress saw an opportunity to help the Republic. Childress believed that the logs of the ''Spire'', which had witnessed Malak's [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], would prove invaluable in defending against an attack like the one on Taris or the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] more recent [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. He sent a team of researchers, accompanied by a commando unit, into the ruins to retrieve the ship's logs.<ref name="TOR" />

However, the wreckage had been already found by a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]], who attacked and killed the commandos. The researchers survived, however, and Childress sent another team into the ''Spire'' to drive out the pirates. The captain had sent a total of five teams into the ship by the time a Republic-allied individual arrived at Waypoint Station Aurek, and Karlsu was a member of the fifth and last group.<ref name="TOR" />

The individual, who had solved a land claim dispute in the Resettlement Project's main city of [[Olaris]], was asked by [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Sakal]] to contact Childress.<ref name="Reclaim">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Reclaiming What's Ours|Taris}}</ref> Childress asked the individual to find the researchers and help them retrieve the logs, so they travelled to the wreckage and entered. The individual found Karlsu near the entrance, and the lieutenant, upon realizing that they were an ally, signalled the remaining researchers to come out from hiding.<ref name="TOR" />

Under the leadership of the individual, Karlsu and the team made their way through the ruined ship to the main computers. Karlsu and the individual fought off the pirates while the researchers retrieved the logs. After they defeated the pirates, Karlsu thanked the individual and told them that he would get the researchers and the data back to Aurek safely.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Karlsu was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in the Taris mission "Wake of the Spire", where Republic players escort him and a group of researchers through the pirate-filled ruins of the ''Endar Spire''.
